scientific.integrity: The claim is derived directly from the published Jacobian trace/determinant identities and the paper reparametrization. The branch equivalence, determinant reduction, transversality derivative, and identity \(D=\omega_H^2\) are exact algebraic consequences; the rational example is only a stress check.
scientific.limitations: The result is local to the positive equilibrium and does not determine Hopf criticality, Lyapunov coefficients, cycle amplitudes, or the open codimension-six maximality problem. An equivalent observation could exist in unindexed or inaccessible older literature.

title: A one-line Hopf criterion and incidence-independent onset frequency in a nonlinear-incidence SIRS model
